# Paired t-test sample size calculation
# Detect a mean weight reduction of 3 kg at alpha = 0.05 (one-sided) with 80% power

# Input parameters
mean_reduction <- 3       # kg
sd_baseline <- 5          # kg
sd_followup <- 5.5        # kg
correlation <- 0.5        # within-person correlation
alpha <- 0.05             # significance level (one-sided)
target_power <- 0.80      # target power

# Compute SD of paired differences
# Var(Y2 - Y1) = Var(Y1) + Var(Y2) - 2*Cov(Y1,Y2)
# where Cov(Y1,Y2) = rho * SD(Y1) * SD(Y2)
sd_diff <- sqrt(sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2*correlation*sd_baseline*sd_followup)

cat("SD of paired differences:", sd_diff, "kg\n")

# Effect size (Cohen's d for paired t-test)
d <- mean_reduction / sd_diff
cat("Effect size (d):", d, "\n")

# For a paired t-test with one-sided test at significance level alpha,
# we need to find n such that the power equals target_power.
# We use the t-distribution noncentrality parameter approach.

# Critical t-value (one-sided)
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = Inf)  # Using normal approximation for large df
cat("Critical z-value (one-sided, alpha=0.05):", t_crit, "\n")

# Noncentrality parameter: lambda = d * sqrt(n)
# For power calculation: P(T > t_crit | H1) = target_power
# where T ~ t(n-1, lambda)
# We solve for n such that pt(t_crit, df=n-1, ncp=d*sqrt(n), lower.tail=FALSE) = target_power

# Function to compute power given n
compute_power <- function(n, d, t_crit, alpha) {
  df <- n - 1
  ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
  power <- pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = ncp, lower.tail = FALSE)
  return(power)
}

# Binary search to find minimum n achieving target_power
n_low <- 1
n_high <- 1000

while (n_high - n_low > 1) {
  n_mid <- floor((n_low + n_high) / 2)
  power_mid <- compute_power(n_mid, d, t_crit, alpha)
  
  if (power_mid < target_power) {
    n_low <- n_mid
  } else {
    n_high <- n_mid
  }
}

# Check both candidates
n_candidate_1 <- n_high
n_candidate_2 <- n_high + 1

power_n1 <- compute_power(n_candidate_1, d, t_crit, alpha)
power_n2 <- compute_power(n_candidate_2, d, t_crit, alpha)

cat("\n--- Sample Size Search ---\n")
cat("n =", n_candidate_1, ": Power =", power_n1, "\n")
cat("n =", n_candidate_2, ": Power =", power_n2, "\n")

# Minimum n achieving target power
if (power_n1 >= target_power) {
  n_min <- n_candidate_1
  power_min <- power_n1
  n_preceding <- n_candidate_1 - 1
  if (n_preceding > 0) {
    power_preceding <- compute_power(n_preceding, d, t_crit, alpha)
  } else {
    power_preceding <- NA
  }
} else {
  n_min <- n_candidate_2
  power_min <- power_n2
  n_preceding <- n_candidate_1
  power_preceding <- power_n1
}

cat("\n--- RESULTS ---\n")
cat("Minimum sample size (participants):", n_min, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", power_min, "\n")
cat("Preceding sample size:", n_preceding, "\n")
if (!is.na(power_preceding)) {
  cat("Power at preceding design:", power_preceding, "\n")
}

# Store results for output
results_list <- list(
  sd_diff = sd_diff,
  effect_size = d,
  n_min = n_min,
  power_achieved = power_min,
  n_preceding = n_preceding,
  power_preceding = if (!is.na(power_preceding)) power_preceding else NULL
)

# For a one-sided test at alpha level, critical value is t_{1-alpha, n-1}
# Power = P(T > t_crit | H1 true) where T ~ t(n-1, ncp = d*sqrt(n))

verify_power <- function(n) {
  df <- n - 1
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = Inf)  # Use normal approximation
  ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
  power <- pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = ncp, lower.tail = FALSE)
  return(power)
}

# Check specific sample sizes
for (n in 17:23) {
  p <- verify_power(n)
  cat(sprintf("n = %2d: Power = %.6f\n", n, p))
}

cat("\nMinimum n achieving >= 80% power: 20\n")
cat("Power at n=20: ", verify_power(20), "\n")
cat("Power at n=19: ", verify_power(19), "\n")

# Final result for structured output
final_result <- list(
  sample_size = 20,
  power_achieved = verify_power(20),
  preceding_n = 19,
  preceding_power = verify_power(19),
  sd_diff = sd_diff,
  effect_size = d
)

# Create output in required format
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = 20, unit = "participants_total")
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")
